items.q: Ken Wood, who was the manager of the Regal Theater... I talked to him at Ken Wood's office for 45 minutes

ctx.x: When I left the Rum Boogie, and I've told you about Ken Wood, who was the manager of the Regal Theater (inaudible), and Charlie Wood didn't like the idea that Ken was promoting me, which he wasn't. He just called me. And Charlie Wood didn't want to lose me directing the band. That's what the whole thing was.
